description: Create, verify, compile, upload, and monitor Arduino sketches with Arduino CLI.
configuration.title: Redbrick Arduino
configuration.cli.path: Path to the Arduino CLI executable. Leave empty to detect Arduino CLI or the copy bundled with Arduino IDE automatically.
configuration.upload.mode: Choose whether Arduino CLI and USB boards are used on this computer or on Raspberry Pi over SSH.
configuration.upload.mode.local: Use Arduino CLI and USB ports on this computer.
configuration.upload.mode.raspberryPi: Use Arduino CLI and USB ports on Raspberry Pi over SSH.
configuration.remote.host: Raspberry Pi IP address or hostname.
configuration.remote.sshKeyPath: Path to the SSH private key. Password authentication is not stored or used.
configuration.remote.cliPath: Path to arduino-cli on Raspberry Pi.
configuration.remote.temporaryRoot: Absolute temporary directory on Raspberry Pi used for synchronized sketches and build output.
